publication.editorialScope: Distinct merchant-specific group dining and voucher intent in 1050 Wien. The district guide receives one contextual backlink to the article.

searchData.opportunity: Specific merchant voucher and Margareten restaurant intent. The title gives the voucher value and spend threshold, and the description gives the district, issue period and on-site condition. The historic NORDSEE and KinoDonnerstag opportunities do not establish demand or CTR for this voucher.

coverageDecisions.finding: The merchant’s publicly accessible November 11 post and captioned embed confirm a EUR 20 voucher issued for EUR 100 or more in on-site consumption December 1–13, 2026. The linked official restaurant site confirms the account, 1050 address and booking contact. December 13 is the final announced issue date. Voucher redemption deadline, immediate use, bill grouping, eligible items and voucher count are unpublished. The separate dated lunch menu supplies a lower-budget comparison without assumed voucher eligibility.
